definitions.explanation: the quality, texture, weight, and characteristics of paper

examples.japanese: この{本|ほん}は{紙質|ししつ}がいい。
examples.english: This book has good paper quality.

examples.japanese: {紙質|ししつ}によって{印刷|いんさつ}の{仕上|しあ}がりが{変|か}わる。
examples.english: The print finish changes depending on the paper quality.

examples.japanese: {写真集|しゃしんしゅう}は{紙質|ししつ}にこだわって、{厚手|あつで}の{光沢紙|こうたくし}を{選|えら}んだ。
examples.english: For the photo book, we chose thick glossy paper, paying close attention to paper quality.

notes:
Combines {紙|し} (paper) and {質|しつ} (quality, nature). Used when discussing printing, publishing, stationery, art supplies, and packaging. Paper quality encompasses factors like thickness, texture, brightness, and how well it holds ink.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {紙質|ししつ}がいい: good paper quality
- {紙質|ししつ}にこだわる: to be particular about paper quality
- {紙質|ししつ}が{悪|わる}い: poor paper quality
- {紙質|ししつ}を{確認|かくにん}する: to check the paper quality

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {用紙|ようし}: paper (for a specific purpose) — paper designated for a particular use
- {画質|がしつ}: image quality — quality of an image or display
- {音質|おんしつ}: sound quality — quality of audio
- {材質|ざいしつ}: material quality — the nature or quality of a material in general
